services.desc: Ahoy, arcade adventurers! We just got back from the latest arcade auction-and trust us, we didn’t return empty-handed. We’re thrilled to announce the arrival of a brand-new game that’s about to shake up the arcade floor: Deadstorm Pirates - and yes, it’s set to free play starting tomorrow! This swashbuckling arcade shooter from Namco is an action-packed thrill ride made for two-player co-op. You’ll be battling ghost ships, sea serpents, and cursed treasure guardians-all while steering your ship with a real, physical wheel!
